## Practical details

**Venue.** Golden Tulip Westlands, Nairobi. Monday 9 to Friday 13 November 2026.

**Evenings.** Dinner together on Monday for instructors, teaching assistants and
participants. A networking evening midweek. Both are optional and both are the
best part of the week.

**Your group.** Ten groups of six. You will meet your group on Wednesday morning
and present with them on Friday.

**Getting set up.** Follow [Getting Started](../../../getting-started.qmd) before
Tuesday morning. You need a GitHub account and the Codespace from the workshop
template repository. If anything fails, find a teaching assistant on Monday
rather than on Tuesday.
